q1_defects.answer: BROKEN: the subject is a featureless solid brown/tan slab at EVERY phase — no brass header, no grey content rows, no accent dot, no dark rounded card panel. idle is a flat uniform tan square (effRGB 121.8,98.5,69.8, warmFrac 1.0). This is the blank-slab/placeholder-plane defect, nothing like the ground-truth card.
evidence: metrics: idle effRGB 121.8,98.5,69.8 warmFrac 1.0 uniform slab

q2_reads_as.answer: Does NOT read as the claimed card folding. The FOLD gesture is present (play-1 folds down the middle, play-2 into a V/booklet, play-3 into a thin near-edge-on strip) but the thing folding is a blank brown sheet, not the card. A user would say 'where did my card go? this is just a brown sheet folding'. Compare ground-truth swap-flip-morph which keeps the full card.

q3_discoverable.answer: Partly. stagger control changes the fold geometry (low=tight bevelled accordion strip, high=open two-panel fold) and reads. But shade control is DEAD — shade-low and shade-high are byte-near-identical (meanAbsDiff 0.482, changedFrac 0).

q4_responsive.answer: Fold motion is responsive (frameDeltaMag 24.5 then 14.9 across play-2/play-3), but responsiveness of a blank slab is moot when the subject itself is wrong.

q5_net.answer: ANNOYED — I scrolled and my card turned into a plain brown sheet that folds up; the whole card look (brass header, rows, dot, panel) is gone, and the shade slider does nothing.

mustFix.issue: Subject is a featureless solid brown/tan slab at every phase and control state — the full card look (brass header bar, blue accent dot, 3 grey content rows, dark rounded panel) is never visible. This is the blank/placeholder-plane defect; the fold geometry must fold the actual CARD, not a blank plane.
